quarterly_data.signal: TeLuRide-005 efficacy in the Q3 company update deck (EIK1001 + pembrolizumab + chemotherapy, first-line NSCLC; data as of May 4, 2026, presented at ASCO 2026, RECIST 1.1): all participants (N = 65 efficacy evaluable / 72 total) ORR 63.1% (95% CI 50.2%-74.7%) and DCR 90.8% (81.0%-96.5%); non-squamous (N = 36 / 39) ORR 55.6% (38.1%-72.1%), DCR 83.3% (67.2%-93.6%), median follow-up 13.6 months; squamous (N = 29 / 33) ORR 72.4% (52.8%-87.3%), DCR 100% (86.3%-100%), median follow-up 8.8 months. Objective responses were observed across all PD-L1 TPS subgroups and the non-squamous median DOR was greater than 11 months. The study is fully enrolled, the squamous data are still maturing, and Eikon says it continues to perform at the high end of company expectations. As the standard-of-care reference the deck cites KEYNOTE-189 (non-squamous) ORR 43% and KEYNOTE-407 (squamous) ORR 55% for pembrolizumab plus chemotherapy.
quarterly_data.figure: ORR 63.1% (all, N = 65), 55.6% (non-squamous, N = 36), 72.4% (squamous, N = 29); DCR 90.8%, 83.3%, 100%; median DOR greater than 11 months (non-squamous)

quarterly_data.signal: TeLuRide-005 safety in the Q3 company update deck (cutoff March 17, 2026; N = 72): EIK1001 is observed to be generally well tolerated, permitting outpatient administration; no DLTs were observed in the safety run-in (N = 13); any TEAE 72 (100%), Grade 3 or higher TEAE 57 (79.2%), Grade 3 or higher drug-related TEAE 35 (48.6%), SAE 36 (50.0%); TEAEs leading to death 9 (12.5%), none related to study treatment; discontinuation 14 (19.4%). The most common Grade 3 or higher treatment-related AE was neutropenia (22, 30.6%); there were no Grade 3 or higher cytokine release syndrome events, and high-grade treatment-related AEs were generally consistent with pembrolizumab / platinum-based chemotherapy.
quarterly_data.figure: Grade 3 or higher TEAE 79.2%; Grade 3 or higher drug-related TEAE 48.6%; Grade 3 or higher neutropenia 30.6%; no treatment-related deaths; no Grade 3 or higher CRS

quarterly_data.signal: EIK1003 monotherapy (Cohort 1A, fully enrolled dose escalation; data as of May 4, 2026, presented at ASCO 2026): ORR 7/49 (14.3%) - breast 2/16 (12.5%), epithelial ovarian 4/27 (14.8%), prostate 1/1 (100%), pancreatic 0/5 (0%), PARPi-naive 4/15 (26.7%); all 7 responses were PRs (5 confirmed, 2 unconfirmed), median DOR in confirmed responders 7.8 months (range 6.0-15.9+), DCR 38.8%. Safety (data as of February 27, 2026; N = 65): Grade 3 or higher TEAEs 29 (44.6%), anemia 6 (9.2%), neutropenia 5 (7.7%), thrombocytopenia 1 (1.5%); TEAEs led to interruption in 33.8%, reduction in 10.8% and discontinuation in 9.2%; no treatment-related AEs led to death.
quarterly_data.figure: ORR 14.3% (7/49); PARPi-naive 26.7% (4/15); median DOR 7.8 months; DCR 38.8%; Grade 3 or higher TEAE 44.6%

quarterly_data.signal: EIK1003 plus paclitaxel (Cohort 1C, fully enrolled dose escalation; data as of May 4, 2026, presented at ASCO 2026): ORR 13/53 (24.5%) - breast 5/26 (19.2%), epithelial ovarian 8/27 (29.6%); prior taxane 12/13 (92%), with prior taxane exposure by tumor type 100% (8/8) ovarian and 80% (4/5) breast; 1 CR (confirmed) and 12 PRs (8 confirmed, 4 unconfirmed); DOR range in confirmed responders 1.5+ to 11.4 months with 3 responses ongoing; DCR 79.2%. Safety (data as of February 27, 2026; N = 60): neutropenia 30 (50%), anemia 8 (13.3%); TEAEs led to interruption in 83.3%, reduction in 25% and discontinuation of either or both drugs in 18.3%; dose-limiting toxicities of febrile neutropenia and tachycardia (1 participant each) occurred at the highest dose tested (EIK1003 60 mg); no treatment-related AEs led to death.

EIK1005 (WRN inhibitor) early clinical data in the Q3 company update deck (presented at ASCO 2026): 23 subjects were dosed in a two-part study (Part 1 N = 15; Part 2 N = 8) at 50mg (Parts 1 and 2) and 100mg (Part 1); all subjects completed the study and all AEs were unrelated and mild except a single moderate AE, with no clinically significant events. T1/2 was 9.4 days, exposure increased in a dose-related manner and no clinically significant food effect was observed; the findings supported a 50mg starting dose for the EIK1005-002 trial. The clinical program was initiated on favorable tumor xenograft results (tumor volume decrease at multiple dose levels in HCT116 xenografts).
quarterly_data.figure: 23 subjects (Part 1 N = 15, Part 2 N = 8); 50mg and 100mg; T1/2 9.4 days; 50mg starting dose for EIK1005-002
